title: Lee et al. 2019 (Motor Imagery) — EEG dataset and OpenBMI toolbox for three BCI paradigms: an investigation into BCI illiteracy
description: This dataset contains EEG recordings from 54 healthy participants performing a binary left/right hand motor imagery task across two sessions on different days. Each session includes offline training and online test phases of 100 trials each, recorded with 62 EEG channels and 4 EMG channels at 1000 Hz. It is the motor imagery component of a larger resource covering three BCI paradigms (MI, ERP, SSVEP), and it supports the study of BCI illiteracy and of variability in decoding performance across subjects and sessions.
methods_description: EEG was recorded at 1000 Hz from 62 Ag/AgCl electrodes with a BrainAmp amplifier, nose-referenced and grounded at AFz, with impedance kept below 10 kOhm. Subjects sat 60 cm from a 21-inch LCD monitor and imagined grasping with the hand indicated by a left or right arrow cue for 4 s, after a 3 s fixation cross. Each of the two sessions had an offline training phase and an online test phase with visual feedback.
